timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹741.66 Cr (+23.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹132.5 Cr (+250.9% YoY).
Northern Arc Capital reported Q4FY26 consolidated PAT of ₹133 Cr on a lending AUM of ₹16,594 Cr.
Northern Arc Capital Limited shared the audio recording link for its Q4 FY2025-26 earnings conference call held on May 8, 2025, via its website.
Northern Arc Capital reported Q4FY26 PAT of ₹133 Cr on an AUM of ₹16,594 Cr.
Northern Arc Capital submitted its monitoring agency report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, confirming full utilization of IPO net proceeds.
On 24 July 2026, ICRA ESG Ratings Limited assigned Northern Arc Capital an [ICRA ESG] Impact Rating of 81, Outstanding.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹779.77 Cr (+28.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹114.33 Cr (+41.1% YoY).
Northern Arc Capital reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹779.77 Cr and net profit of ₹114.33 Cr, with AUM reaching ₹16,855 Cr.
2026-08-03: Northern Arc Capital Limited filed transcript of Q1FY27 earnings call held on July 27, 2026
2026-08-14: Northern Arc Capital informed exchanges about RBI penalty of ₹0.06 Cr for FY25 reporting non-compliance
2026-08-18: Northern Arc Capital held 18th AGM, approved ₹5,000 Cr NCD issuance and appointed joint statutory auditors

Northern Arc Capital Limited’s 18th AGM on August 18, 2026, approved audited financial statements (50,122,876 votes for) and appointed Vijay Nallan Chakravarthi (DIN: 08020248) as director (50,122,857 votes for).
